component.name: PyCharm Community
component.summary: Open-source Python IDE with a debugger and test runner

description.p: PyCharm Community is an open-source Python IDE with code completion, refactoring, an integrated debugger, a test runner and version control.

This community package installs the unmodified official Community build from JetBrains' intellij-community GitHub releases. It follows the current open-source releases; the discontinued Flathub Community package remains on 2024.3.4. This is the PC product, not the unified Professional build.

Python, Git and development tools come from the Freedesktop SDK inside the sandbox. Host interpreters, host virtual environments and system services are not directly usable. Create project virtual environments with the sandbox's /usr/bin/python3 interpreter. Keep projects and their virtual environments in your Documents directory, which the IDE can read and write. Its settings are kept separately inside its Flatpak profile.
The embedded browser, including built-in HTML and Markdown previews, is suspended with the default sandbox configuration.
